title: Celebrating the legacy and contributions of immigrants and opposing discriminatory immigration policies.
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: This resolution recognizes and celebrates the contributions of immigrants to the United States; condemns discrimination against immigrants; and supports comprehensive immigration reform that addresses the needs of the economy, strengthens communities, and reflects the values of compassion, fairness, and opportunity for all.

actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on the Judiciary.
